name: smwmusic-crash-bash-pogo-painter
title: Crash Bash - Pogo Painter
description:
A jazzy remix of Crash Bandicoot 3 Warped's main theme that plays in Pogo Painter, the first pogo minigame in Crash Bash, which is set in a jungle.

Includes two versions, one which isn't compatible with thunder and yoshi and has two extra samples
